# Waivers for the release gate's vulnerability checks (.github/workflows/release-gate.yml): an
# Arch security tracker group (AVG-…) or an issue id (CVE-…).
# One per line:  <vulnerability-id> <expires YYYY-MM-DD> <owner> <reason...>
# A waiver past its expiry date FAILS the gate on its own, so it is renewed on purpose or the
# package is fixed. Keep this list short; every entry is a known risk shipped to users.
#
# (no waivers)
